title: Cerebras stock plunges 14% after second earnings report following IPO
summary: Cerebras Systems experienced a significant decline in its stock price, dropping 14% after the release of its second earnings report following its initial public offering (IPO). Despite this downturn, the company reported revenue that exceeded expectations for the second quarter and subsequently raised its full-year guidance. This mixed performance reflects the volatility often seen in the tech sector, particularly among newly public companies.
